{{Quote|Consider, if you will, the Ailon Nova Guard. They are fierce fighters who are also highly disciplined, and in my experience the latter is a rare quality among non-Humans.|[[Rom Mohc]]|<ref name="Handbook" />}}
The '''Ailon Nova Guard''', also simply the '''Nova Guard''', was the military force of [[Ailon/Legends|Ailon]], renowned for a martial prowess on par with the [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Imperial Royal Guard]] and the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]].<ref name="COMP" />

==Philosophy==
Members of the Nova Guard were drilled from birth in military history and tactics.<ref name="GaW" /> Prizing physical toughness and survival of the fittest, Nova Guard had a near-religious devotion to martial tradition and trained to the highest possible standard, ensuring that the soldiers of the Nova Guard were professional under every circumstance; cowards were uncovered and executed long before they had the chance to shame their regiments in combat.<ref name="GaW" /> Combat was so central to the Nova Guard that those who were rejected from military service - or worse, expelled from their ranks - would exile themselves from their homeworld in disgrace.<ref name="GaW" />

A minimum five-year tour of duty was mandatory for all [[Ailon (species)|Ailon]], with trainees considered active-duty personnel; in battle, Nova Guard were known for their ability to outthink, outflank, and overwhelm their enemies.<ref name="GaW" /> It was common for individual soldiers of the Nova Guard to be shocked by the relative inexperience and lack of training in their foes.<ref name="GaW" /> While Nova Guard were exceptionally well trained in all aspects of modern warfare, they held hand-to-hand and melee combat in high esteem, often wielding [[Polearm/Legends|polearms]] and the traditional [[Eklot]] alongside more conventional weaponry.<ref name="AJ15" /><ref name="GaW" />

The annual [[Ailon Military Ceremonies]] were a major tourist attraction for the [[Ailon system/Legends|Ailon system]], and were broadcast [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-wide. During the reign of the Empire, elite Imperial units also participated in these parades and ceremonies.

==History==
[[File:AilonNovaGuard-GAW.jpg|thumb|left|300px|The Ailon Nova Guard]]
An ancient military service with 13,000 years of history and tradition, the Ailon Nova Guard had been allied to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] for millennia.<ref name="AJ15" /> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Nova Guard fought for the Galactic Republic and participated in at least two battles, the [[Battle of Ord Canfre]] and the [[Battle of Bassadro]]. The Nova Guard was also said to have participated in the [[Mission to Norval II|slaughter]] of the [[Mandalorian Protectors (Spar)|Mandalorian Protectors]] at [[Norval II]].<ref name="GaW" />

After the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the Nova Guard believed that [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] embodied their belief, and supported him however they could. The [[Humanocentrism|Humanocentric]] Empire took advantage of this, and often hired them for "glorious" battles which were really suicide missions. They were used as disposable assets and their deaths in combat provided Imperial commanders with real-time intelligence on enemy firepower.<ref name="AJ15" /><ref name="Handbook">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref> However, this also led to several embarrassing incidents when the Nova Guard overran the enemy before the Imperial military could act.<ref name="AJ15" /> Two notable missions by the Nova Guard during this period were the toppling of [[King/Legends|King]] [[Satyr Azzlectico]] and the [[Sundering of Slession]].<ref name="GaW" />

Outside of these missions, Nova Guard activity was greatly curtailed under the Empire and largely restricted to ceremonial duties. The primary focus of the Nova Guard became the annual Ailon Military Ceremonies, during which the Guard honed its skills, upgraded its equipment, observed the martial traditions of other species, and staged war-games. Due to the Ailon's high birth rate, the Nova Guard regiments were filled to capacity, with entire new regiments created to train the youth.<ref name="AJ15" />

By the time of the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], during which Emperor Palpatine was killed, the Ailon had a massive, well-trained, yet mostly inexperienced military. However, the [[Imperial High Command/Legends|Imperial Central Command]] still kept them out of most of the post-Endor [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|war]] out of Humanocentrism. When it became clear that the Empire was losing, the Ailon Marshallate swore allegiance to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="AJ15" />

The ensuing Nova Guard campaign wiped out Imperial forces from a score of worlds and aided the New Republic in the removal of Imperial forces from the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. During these battles, many regiments gained their first battle-honors and shook out less qualified troopers and officers. After these successes, the Nova Guard joined the effort to liberate the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]], targeting a number of fortress worlds in the region.<ref name="AJ15" /><ref name="GaW" />

Following [[Operation Shadow Hand]] and the New Republic's recapture of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], Captain [[Zgorth'sth]] of the New Republic [[Department of Threat Assessment]] composed a threat assessment on the Ailon Nova Guard, warning that the Guard would only remain loyal to the New Republic while the government remained strong and in control, and that if the New Republic were to demonstrate critical weakness or ineptitude, the Guard would allow them to suffer the fate of the weak.<ref name="AJ15" />

Zgorth'sth's warnings were proven true during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], during which the Ailon Nova Guard were awed by the military might of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] and aided the extragalactic invaders in conquering the Inner Rim, most notably [[Cona/Legends|Cona]], [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]], and [[Zeltros/Legends|Zeltros]]. Because of their actions, their homeworld was subjected to crippling economic sanctions in the post-war era.<ref name="GaW" />

==Organization and Philosophy==
[[File:Ailon_Nova_Guard_SWJ15.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Ailon Nova Guard]]
Numbering close to a billion soldiers, the Ailon Nova Guard was one of the most successful and fiercest fighting forces in the galaxy, a characteristic clearly visible in the organization of its ranks. Upon entering the Nova Guard, a new recruit would be given the rank of [[guardsman]] and could be promoted from there on. The next rank was [[Corporal/Legends|corporal]] who led a group of forty men called a section. Next came [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] who led a platoon which consisted of six sections. A [[Major/Legends|major]], who led a company which was made up of eight platoons, came after lieutenant. Next came the position of [[Lieutenant Colonel/Legends|lieutenant colonel]] who led battalions which were made up of eight companies. A [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] who led a regiment, a group consisting of two or more battalions, was the next rank up from lieutenant colonel. Next came [[Major General]]s who led a division, which was made of six regiments. Next came [[Field Marshal/Legends|Field Marshals]] who led corps, all of whom made up the [[Ailon Marshallate]], an elite command force that also doubled as a Ruling Council. The Supreme Commander of the Ailon Nova Guard was the [[High Marshal of Ailon]].
